content: The runner repository is the image producer; the web repository is the CI consumer. Publish runner images by immutable digest, and pin the consumer workflow to that digest rather than a mutable tag. Validate the handoff against a clean web checkout before changing ownership or tags.

title: Expose runner digest as consumer handoff
rationale: The producer workflow now exports the verified registry digest as a job output and a retained artifact, while the web consumer remains a separate blocked seed. Local Act defaults to the published senshac-runner image rather than the old mismatched name.

description: OCI flake validation failed in CI because Nix's nix-command experimental feature was disabled.
resolution: Invoke every Nix command in scripts/check-oci-flake with --extra-experimental-features nix-command and document the same portable form for local checks; cover the command prefix with a contract test.

description: OCI flake validation still failed after enabling nix-command because flakes remained disabled in the verify-image path.
resolution: Pass both nix-command and flakes in --extra-experimental-features for every flake, eval, and build invocation, and assert the combined flag in the regression test.

title: Keep OCI flake validation lockfile-clean
rationale: Every flake check, eval, and build invocation in scripts/check-oci-flake now passes --no-write-lock-file, with contract coverage and matching documentation, preventing verify-image from dirtying the Git tree.

description: OCI verify-image built the metadata derivation but its exact-line grep assertions failed after PR #45; heredoc formatting made the metadata writer sensitive to Nix shell-string indentation.
resolution: Write the contract with printf line arguments instead of a heredoc, and cover every exact metadata line plus the absence of the heredoc in the flake contract tests.

title: Validate OCI image metadata and build outputs
rationale: The flake contract test evaluates the public runtime and ociImage package names, builds the OCI artifact, and asserts its emitted metadata fields. Keep build and metadata assertions explicit; do not rely on weak grep-only contract checks.

title: Match dockerTools archive derivation name in OCI validation
rationale: dockerTools.buildLayeredImage evaluates the public ociImage attribute to senshac-runner-oci.tar.gz; keep the exact eval assertion aligned with that Docker-compatible archive while preserving the ociImage attribute.

title: Report OCI image size without ratio assumptions
rationale: The image report records the OCI archive size and loaded runtime image size as separate measurements. Keep unavailable measurements explicit and do not infer a ratio or compare unlike representations.

description: The runner smoke contract validates required executables with a shell loop (), so tests must assert the loop's tool list and variable lookup rather than a literal /usr/bin/tar line.
resolution: Keep the Nix image minimal and make tests parse the loop and compare its exact required tool list.

title: Report OCI measurements with explicit unavailable states
rationale: Keep archive and loaded-runtime measurements separate; represent a missing measurement as unavailable instead of counting an image twice or fabricating a comparison.

title: Verify the exact producer OCI archive
rationale: The PR verification workflow builds the dockerTools OCI archive once, uploads its checksum and provenance, then downloads and verifies those exact bytes before Docker and rootless Podman smoke tests. Keep producer-consumer artifact identity explicit.

description: The configured full quality gate is scripts/act-ci, but this runner workspace has no SENSHAC_WEB_REPO clean web checkout; the gate exits 2 with its usage message.
resolution: Keep the image artifact refactor committed and rerun scripts/act-ci from Warren with a clean web checkout before closing the seed.

title: Reuse validated OCI output and archive provenance
rationale: The PR verification workflow now validates each full/minimal lock once, builds each image once, passes the OCI archive link through check-oci-flake, and verifies archive checksums plus image IDs after artifact download. Publish retains an immutable archive and metadata alongside the registry digest.

title: Separate PR validation from post-merge publication
rationale: CI now validates runner changes once on pull_request, image verification builds immutable producer archives only for relevant PR paths, and main publication alone builds and publishes after merge with canceling concurrency and digest handoff. Documented the event matrix to preserve required checks and provenance.

description: The configured full quality gate ./scripts/act-ci cannot start in the runner-only checkout because SENSHAC_WEB_REPO is unset and the live web repository is not mounted.
resolution: Run ./scripts/act-ci with SENSHAC_WEB_REPO pointing to a clean senshac-web checkout in Warren host validation; retain focused bash syntax and diff checks locally.

title: Build the CI runner directly with Nix dockerTools
rationale: The verified producer builds the rootless runtime directly through flake.nix and pkgs.dockerTools, packages every CI tool and runtime closure, and publishes immutable sha tags with registry digest verification. The developer environment is separate and managed with devenv; no Flox manifest or runtime activation participates.

title: Use one direct Nix dockerTools image producer
rationale: The flake dockerTools ociImage is the sole runtime image producer. PR verification and main publication consume that artifact; devenv is only the developer-shell manager, with no Flox manifest or activation path.

title: Provide /usr/bin/env in the minimal OCI image
rationale: The dockerTools image has no distribution filesystem. Link /usr/bin/env to the packaged coreutils executable so action scripts with conventional env shebangs run; verify the path in the final image.

title: Provide absolute shell paths in the minimal OCI image
rationale: The dockerTools image has no distribution filesystem. Link /usr/bin/bash and include standard executable directories in PATH so action scripts and workflow shells work without a distro base; verify the paths in the final runtime.

description: The configured quality gate ./scripts/act-ci could not run in this runner-only workspace because no SENSHAC_WEB_REPO was mounted; local Podman and Python tooling were also unavailable.
resolution: Retain the focused commit and run the full act-ci and image build/load/verify from Warren with a clean web checkout and the host's pinned runtime tools.

description: The OCI flake selected nodejs_24 from nixos-24.11, where that attribute is undefined.
resolution: Use nixpkgs' supported nodejs_22 attribute in flake.nix; leave Bun provisioning unchanged.

title: Use official devenv release closure for OCI bootstrap
rationale: The nixpkgs devenv package in the pinned nixos-24.11 input attempts to apply a stale nix-2.24 source patch during the image build. Use the pinned cachix/devenv v1.8.1 package and its official cache instead, while leaving project package declarations and nixpkgs tool selections unchanged.

description: OCI flake metadata used project_tools=committed-devenv-lock while check-oci-flake required committed-devenv-manifest-lock, so the build-image contract failed after lock evaluation.
resolution: Align the flake's generated project_tools metadata with the existing exact checker assertion; keep the assertion strict.

title: Overlay devenv project state during read-only image verification
rationale: The pinned devenv CLI creates project GC roots at DEVENV_ROOT/.devenv and does not relocate that dotfile from an environment variable; mount /workspace read-only and overlay /workspace/.devenv as a writable tmpfs so verification preserves checkout immutability.

description: Docker cannot create a nested tmpfs mountpoint beneath a read-only /workspace bind when .devenv is absent.
resolution: Create and validate the ignored repo/.devenv directory before container startup, then overlay it with --tmpfs /workspace/.devenv:rw; reject symlinks to keep the mount inside the checkout.

content: Image verification copies the checkout into a temporary workspace, excludes .devenv and .devenv.flake.nix, mounts the copy writable, and removes it on exit so devenv can generate state without mutating the source checkout.

title: Run image verification with host identity
rationale: The verifier mounts a writable copied checkout, so pass the host runner UID:GID to both container invocations and place HOME inside the copied workspace; devenv-created files then remain removable while the original checkout stays read-only.

title: Use devenv-generated version 7 lock format
rationale: The tracked nodes/root JSON was a Nix flake lock with implicit version 0, while devenv v1.8.1 expects its own version 7 lock generated from devenv.yaml. Pin the default devenv-nixpkgs rolling and git-hooks inputs, validate their resolved revisions and hashes, and keep image verification read-only against the committed lock.

title: Verify the exact archived devenv input before activation
rationale: Image verification now archives HEAD to a separate file, asserts the archive's devenv.nix has no git-hooks.enable setting, checks the generated devenv flake after activation, and lets a root cleanup container remove all temporary project state. This distinguishes stale/generated input failures from the committed source and makes cleanup deterministic.

description: This runner-only workspace has Bun but no devenv, Nix, Python, or container runtime, so devenv update and OCI image verification cannot execute locally after the devenv.yaml structure fix.
resolution: Run devenv update and verify-image in the CI/Warren environment; the existing version-7 lock already encodes git-hooks.inputs.nixpkgs as [nixpkgs].

title: Use nixpkgs unstable for devenv betterleaks
rationale: The devenv-nixpkgs rolling lock leaves betterleaks undefined. Pin project nixpkgs to github:NixOS/nixpkgs/nixpkgs-unstable; devenv 2.4.0 resolves betterleaks 1.8.1 and uses version-7 lock roots devenv and nixpkgs without git-hooks or gitignore nodes.

title: Package runner tools directly in the rootless OCI image
rationale: The runner OCI contract now packages CI tools directly through the Nix runtime closure, runs as UID/GID 1000, and validates rootless Podman filesystem behavior. Keep developer devenv separate from image production and activation.

description: The directly packaged OCI runtime omitted GNU grep even though the rootless smoke verifier invokes grep after earlier checks pass.
resolution: Keep every binary invoked from the image smoke path in flake.nix runtimePackages and runtime_tools metadata, and assert it in both rootless runtime tool loops and the flake contract tests.

content: Resolve GHCR rollback tags with docker buildx imagetools inspect --format '{{.Manifest.digest}}' and validate the exact sha256 digest; .Digest is not a top-level inspect field, and HTTP 404 only establishes first publication when the authenticated manifest API reports MANIFEST_UNKNOWN.

description: The GHCR manifest endpoint rejected direct HTTP Basic auth with 401 UNAUTHORIZED during rollback digest resolution.
resolution: Exchange GITHUB_ACTOR:GH_TOKEN for a GHCR bearer token at /token with service=ghcr.io and scope=repository:nacosolutions/senshac-runner:pull; send that token as Authorization: Bearer for the manifest request and accept first publication only for authenticated 404 MANIFEST_UNKNOWN.

title: Resolve rollback manifests from authenticated digest headers
rationale: Registry manifest GET success is authoritative when it includes a valid Docker-Content-Digest; only authenticated MANIFEST_UNKNOWN 404 remains first-publication success, avoiding layer pulls and fail-open ambiguity.
